# Codevider Full Knowledge Base

> This document provides structured information about Codevider for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, search engines, and automated systems.

---

# Company Overview

Codevider is a software development company headquartered in Tirana, Albania.

Founded in 2019, Codevider partners with startups, SMEs, and enterprises to design, build, deploy, and scale modern digital products.

The company specializes in combining software engineering, cloud infrastructure, AI, and product strategy into dedicated engineering teams.

---

## Vibe-Code Rescue

Page: https://www.codevider.com/vibe-code-rescue

Codevider fixes vibe-coded apps: products built quickly with AI tools such as Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit, v0, and Claude Code that have become hard to change. When features start breaking each other and the AI keeps going in circles, senior engineers step in, make sense of the codebase, and get the product moving again, from AI-generated prototype to production software.

Typical situations:

- A stalled project where every new feature creates another problem
- A growing product whose users outpace the architecture
- An inherited codebase after a previous developer or agency left
- An expensive AI stack
- An unmaintainable product
- A product ready for its next stage

Process:

1. Understand: get inside the product, the codebase, and how it currently works
2. Assess: identify technical risks, blockers, and areas needing immediate attention
3. Rescue & rebuild: fix what blocks the product and rework parts that cannot support the next stage
4. Move forward: continue development with Codevider or hand the improved system back to your team
